claim_ceiling: S2 instrument code plus PC evidence only; zero environment-validity, mechanism, user-model, social, subjectivity, agency, or EGO-mainline claims
problem_definition: Repair S1 generator audit blockers, then implement S2 exact-grid ideal-observer instrumentation and PC-IDEAL-SANITY evidence without modifying frozen governance sources.

candidates.name: minimal_implementation
candidates.description: Patch only the simulator session counter/NULL_ENV leak, add a narrow exact-grid observer sufficient for the no-camouflage PC.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Focused unit tests and a PC sanity artifact showing the observer can recover an enumerable micro-config.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Action-only/probe-label lookup can match if the PC uses a single deterministic probe action or leaks action names as labels.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: High if PC queries are fixed to one theta atom, if expected values are literal-coded, or if filter variants fork into independent logic paths.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Shuffle controlled theta across all probe actions; the posterior must track observations through likelihood calls rather than action name literals.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: PC passes but does not prove tractable full S2 behavior beyond the micro-config.

candidates.name: strongest_baseline_shortcut_explanation
candidates.description: Treat S2 as an action-symbol lookup or fixed-probe decoder with access to the micro-config schedule.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Can produce high PC accuracy on a narrow no-camouflage schedule without maintaining a Bayes posterior.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: It is itself the shortcut baseline: table lookup over observed probe symbol centers.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: High: would conflate renderer-visible probe codes with latent inference and would not satisfy exact Bayes or prefix-only requirements.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Require posterior normalization, multiple theta atoms, and likelihood recomputation from simulator distributions for every prefix event.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Fails when symbols are remapped, history is truncated, or action set includes passive/task actions.

candidates.name: mechanism_faithful_implementation
candidates.description: One exact-grid Bayes core enumerates the frozen D1 theta grid, maintains per-atom trust/session state through prefix events, and exposes all variants as thin policy/history wrappers.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Callable producer paths for PC-IDEAL-SANITY, tractability timing, posterior update provenance, and wrapper parity.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: A table decoder can still match the no-camouflage PC but cannot provide normalized posterior state or thin-wrapper equivalence over the same core.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Medium: the filter has generator access by design, so tests must prove it consumes only prefix observation/action events and not hidden user state.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Construct histories from public step outputs only, remove latent user objects before filter update, and require PC failure manifest on subthreshold sanity.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Combinatorial wall-clock blowup or state synchronization drift between simulator sessions and filter atoms.

selection_reason: It is the only candidate that can satisfy exact Bayes, prefix-only, thin-wrapper, and tractability logging without claiming S5 environment validity.

frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.null_env_control_rule: NULL_ENV response distributions must be invariant to controlled theta for all actions including probes.
frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.session_rule: 20 sessions x 15 turns; z is reinitialized from stationary distribution at each session start; trust persists.
frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.baseline_boundary: S2 wrappers are oracle/policy instrumentation only; fair battery baselines remain S3.
frozen_metric_baseline_ablation_contract.ablation_boundary: Only generator audit fixes and PC-IDEAL-SANITY are executed here; no S5 ablation verdicts.

stop_conditions: filter cannot update from prefix-only event records
any protected frozen source is modified
rollback_plan: Revert only files added or edited under src/fsp_pum_env, tests/fsp_pum_env, and artifacts/FSP-PUM-ENV-IDPROBE-001A; do not touch git index or commits.
